note: Patterns that map the compiler's first error to a class of the model's CheckError, tried in order. A failed instantiation's first error carries the note of the constraint that failed. 'has no attribute 'copy'' comes before unknownField: the compiler reports .copy() of a value that is not Copyable as a missing attribute, the model as notCopyable. 'does not designate a value with an origin', the compiler's error for moving an element out of a list or an array, comes before escapingReference, whose pattern also matches 'origin'. 'use of invalidated interior reference' is the compiler's error for a reference to a list element used after the list changed. In the subset, only a struct that holds a list or an array of itself has a field of a non-'Deinitable' type. 'does not conform to trait 'Writable'' is the compiler's error for printing a value that print cannot write.
